theorems.name: Submission.sobolev_of_superlevel_inequality
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (H : Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (h : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (C : ℝ), 2 ≤ n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ (V.tangentSpace x).starProjection) V.weight → IsOpen U → LocallyIntegrableOn H U V.weight → 0 ≤ C → (∀ g : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g U → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) → ∫ x in {x | 1 ≤ g x}, g x ∂V.weight ≤ C * (∫ x, g x ∂V.weight) ^ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∫ x, (‖V.tangentialGradient g x‖ + g x * ‖H x‖) ∂V.weight) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 h U → HasCompactSupport h → tsupport h ⊆ U → (∀ x, 0 ≤ h x) → (∫ x, h x ^ ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) - 1)) ∂V.weight) ^ (((n : ℝ) - 1) / n) ≤ (n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) - 1) * C * ∫ x, (‖V.tangentialGradient h x‖ + h x * ‖H x‖) ∂V.weight
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
